referer.description: The origin from which the visit was performed

date.description: The date in which the visit was performed, in UTC

userAgent.description: The user agent from which the visit was performed

potentialBot.description: Tells if Shlink thinks this visit comes potentially from a bot or crawler

visitedUrl.description: The originally visited URL that triggered the tracking of this visit

redirectUrl.description: The URL to which the visitor was redirected, or null if a redirect did not occur, like for 404 requests or pixel tracking

id.description: This visit's own stable identity, which is never reused

deviceType.description: The device class assigned to this visit. Anything not positively recognized as mobile, tablet or desktop is reported as other, never as desktop. Null for imported visits and visits captured before device classification existed

deviceTypeDetail.description: The underlying device type the other class stands for (smart-tv, console), or unknown where it could not be determined. Null when deviceType is not other
